Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 for prostate cancer. Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Filter by efo_term = 'prostate cancer'. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
